mainCard.title:
In one line:
a full commission for your repo
paragraphs: RepoChan is a CLI + agent skills pipeline. Hand it a git repo and it works like a mini creative team: it reads the repo and writes an analysis, asks you a few interview-style questions, then produces a mascot persona, a foundation sheet, stickers, textures, posters — and finally assembles a landing page.
Every step is an atomic repochan subcommand; creative judgment stays with your own agent. No black box, no embedded runtime.
mainCard.scribble: This very issue was born the same way → every image on the page is real order output. That's dogfooding.
